end.summary: Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised building numbers as ten plus extra ones, including 11, 13, 14, 15, and 16. They used the bundle-and-loose-sticks method and gave one correct unaided response across two attempts. Saanvi mixed up the tens digit with the number of loose ones; this was still present in the final responses and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use sticks or pencils to make one group of ten, then add loose ones for numbers 11–20.
